pages.markdown: In this content, DPN Argentina provides a brief explanation of the SDGs and the 2030 Agenda action plans, and most importantly, their role in advancing the 2030 Agenda through the SDGs Monitoring and Evaluation Program with a focus on certain thematic areas. These focuses allow DPN Argentina to investigate through monitoring and preparing reports on the development of public policies and actions of organizations responsible for compliance with the SDGs, as well as proposals, and recommendations to strengthen related processes. Furthermore, DPN Argentina also regularly uploads commemorations of days related to the SDGs by also including the SDGs logo in each of these uploads. Examples of such greetings are as follows: Día Mundial de la #Salud La cobertura sanitaria universal es el objetivo primordial de la @opsoms. Para lograrlo es crucial que todas las personas puedan tener la atención que necesitan, en el seno mismo de la comunidad.
